124	
125	class WebSocket:
126	    def __init__(self, url):
127	        host_port, path = url[5:].split("/", 1)
128	        if ":" in host_port:
129	            host, port = host_port.rsplit(":", 1)
130	            port = int(port)
131	        else:
132	            host, port = host_port, 80
133	        self.sock = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=10)
134	        key = base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16)).decode()
135	        self.sock.sendall(
136	            f"GET /{path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {host_port}\r\n"
137	            "Upgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\n"
138	            f"Sec-WebSocket-Key: {key}\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n\r\n".encode())
139	        head = b""
140	        while b"\r\n\r\n" not in head:
141	            chunk = self.sock.recv(4096)
142	            if not chunk:
143	                raise RuntimeError("WebSocket 握手失败：连接已关闭")
144	            head += chunk
145	        if b" 101 " not in head.split(b"\r\n", 1)[0]:
146	            raise RuntimeError(f"WebSocket 握手被拒绝：{head[:120]!r}")
147	        self._buf = head.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)[1]
148	        self._send_lock = threading.Lock()
149	        self._cond = threading.Condition()
150	        self._results = {}
151	        self._events = []
152	        self._next_id = 0
153	        self._closed = False
154	        self._reader = threading.Thread(target=self._read_loop, daemon=True)
155	        self._reader.start()
156	
157	    def _send_text(self, text):
158	        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
159	        mask = os.urandom(4)
160	        n = len(payload)
161	        prefix = bytearray([0x81])
162	        if n < 126:
163	            prefix.append(0x80 | n)
164	        elif n < 65536:
165	            prefix.append(0x80 | 126)
166	            prefix += struct.pack(">H", n)
167	        else:
168	            prefix.append(0x80 | 127)
169	            prefix += struct.pack(">Q", n)
170	        masked = bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(payload))
171	        with self._send_lock:
172	            self.sock.sendall(bytes(prefix) + mask + masked)
173	
174	    def _read_exact(self, n):
175	        while len(self._buf) < n:
176	            chunk = self.sock.recv(65536)
177	            if not chunk:
178	                raise OSError("连接关闭")
179	            self._buf += chunk
180	        out, self._buf = self._buf[:n], self._buf[n:]
181	        return out
182	
183	    def _read_message(self):
184	        chunks = []
185	        b0, b1 = self._read_exact(2)
186	        fin = bool(b0 & 0x80)
187	        opcode = b0 & 0x0F
188	        n = b1 & 0x7F
189	        if n == 126:
190	            n = struct.unpack(">H", self._read_exact(2))[0]
191	        elif n == 127:
192	            n = struct.unpack(">Q", self._read_exact(8))[0]
193	        data = self._read_exact(n) if n else b""
194	        if not fin:  # 分片帧（CDP 一般不发送），拼到 FIN 为止
195	            while True:
196	                c0, c1 = self._read_exact(2)
197	                cn = c1 & 0x7F
198	                if cn == 126:
199	                    cn = struct.unpack(">H", self._read_exact(2))[0]
200	                elif cn == 127:
201	                    cn = struct.unpack(">Q", self._read_exact(8))[0]
202	                data += self._read_exact(cn) if cn else b""
203	                if c0 & 0x80:
204	                    break
205	        if opcode == 0x9:  # ping -> pong
206	            with self._send_lock:
207	                self.sock.sendall(b"\x8A\x00")
208	            return None
209	        if opcode == 0x8:  # close
210	            raise OSError("收到 close 帧")
211	        if opcode != 0x1:
212	            return None
213	        return json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"))
214	
215	    def _read_loop(self):
216	        while not self._closed:
217	            try:
218	                message = self._read_message()
219	            except OSError:
220	                break
221	            if message is None:
222	                continue
223	            with self._cond:
224	                if "id" in message:
225	                    self._results[message["id"]] = message
226	                else:
227	                    self._events.append(message)
228	                self._cond.notify_all()
229	
230	    def call(self, method, params=None, *, session_id=None, timeout=15):
231	        with self._cond:
232	            self._next_id += 1
233	            msg_id = self._next_id
234	        message = {"id": msg_id, "method": method, "params": params or {}}
235	        if session_id:
236	            message["sessionId"] = session_id
237	        self._send_text(json.dumps(message))
238	        end = time.time() + timeout
239	        with self._cond:
240	            while msg_id not in self._results:
241	                remaining = end - time.time()
242	                if remaining <= 0:
243	                    raise TimeoutError(f"CDP 调用超时：{method}")
244	                self._cond.wait(remaining)
245	            result = self._results.pop(msg_id)
246	        if "error" in result:
247	            raise RuntimeError(f"CDP 错误（{method}）：{result['error']}")
248	        return result.get("result", {})
249	
250	    def drain_events(self, timeout=0.1):
251	        """等待并取出缓存的全部事件（命令响应不会混入）。"""
252	        end = time.time() + timeout
253	        with self._cond:
254	            while not self._events and time.time() < end:
255	                self._cond.wait(max(0.0, end - time.time()))
256	            events, self._events = self._events, []
257	            return events
258	
259	    def push_events(self, events):
260	        """把不属于调用方的事件放回队列，供其它等待者继续观察。"""
261	        with self._cond:
262	            self._events.extend(events)
263	            self._cond.notify_all()
264	
265	    def close(self):
266	        self._closed = True
267	        with self._send_lock:
268	            try:
269	                self.sock.close()
270	            except OSError:
271	                pass

425	    def __init__(self, ws, target_id, session_id):
426	        self.ws = ws
427	        self.target_id = target_id
428	        self.session = session_id
429	        self.held_lists = []    # 被挂起的列表读取（GET /api/surveys，按到达顺序）
430	        self.held_posts = []    # 被挂起的创建请求（POST /api/surveys，按到达顺序）
431	        self._held_cond = threading.Condition()
432	        self._pumping = False

434	    def prepare(self):
435	        self.call("Page.enable")
436	        self.call("Runtime.enable")
437	        self.call("Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", {"source": TEST_HELPERS})
438	        # 后台持续运转 CDP 事件：拦截开启期间，除“列表读取”和“创建请求”外的
439	        # 请求（详情 GET、PUT、静态资源等）必须立即放行，否则页面自己的其它
440	        # 请求会被挂起饿死；被挂起的两类请求按到达顺序收集，交给测试决定
441	        # 每一次何时、以何种结果返回。
442	        self._pumping = True
443	        self._pump_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._event_loop, daemon=True)
444	        self._pump_thread.start()
445	
446	    def _event_loop(self):
447	        while self._pumping:
448	            try:
449	                events = self.ws.drain_events(0.2)
450	            except OSError:
451	                break
452	            passthrough = []
453	            for event in events:
454	                # 同一根 WebSocket 承载着浏览器里所有标签页的事件：只处理属于
455	                # 本会话的，其它会话的事件原样放回，交给对应页面的循环处理，
456	                # 绝不能按本页会话误放行/误收集（否则被挂起的请求会永远卡住）。
457	                if event.get("sessionId") not in (None, self.session):
458	                    passthrough.append(event)
459	                    continue
460	                if event.get("method") == "Fetch.requestPaused":
461	                    params = event["params"]
462	                    request = params["request"]
463	                    path = urlsplit(request["url"]).path
464	                    if request["method"] == "GET" and path == "/api/surveys":
465	                        with self._held_cond:
466	                            self.held_lists.append(params)
467	                            self._held_cond.notify_all()
468	                        continue
469	                    if request["method"] == "POST" and path == "/api/surveys":
470	                        with self._held_cond:
471	                            self.held_posts.append(params)
472	                            self._held_cond.notify_all()
473	                        continue
474	                    try:
475	                        self.call("Fetch.continueRequest",
476	                                  {"requestId": params["requestId"]})
477	                    except Exception:
478	                        pass
479	                else:
480	                    passthrough.append(event)
481	            if passthrough:
482	                self.ws.push_events(passthrough)

484	    def call(self, method, params=None, timeout=15):
485	        return self.ws.call(method, params, session_id=self.session, timeout=timeout)

487	    def close(self):

489	        # WebSocket，若不及时退出会把新页被挂起的请求抢走（按旧会话处理），
490	        # 造成后续测试莫名超时。

524	                    # 拦截已开启时，导航期间就可能有请求被挂起（首页的首次列表

527	                    # 挂起的请求会永远卡住。
528	                    self.ws.push_events(leftover + batch[i + 1:])

544	        """让后台拦截循环、微任务与异步回调有机会落地。"""
545	        time.sleep(seconds)

548

550	        """挂起 GET/POST /api/surveys；详情 GET、PUT 等由后台事件循环立即放行。"""
551	        with self._held_cond:
552	            self.held_lists = []

559	        end = time.time() + timeout
560	        with self._held_cond:
561	            while len(self.held_lists) <= index and time.time() < end:
562	                self._held_cond.wait(max(0.0, end - time.time()))

566

572	        """取出（并移除）最早一个被挂起的创建请求。"""
573	        end = time.time() + timeout

602	        """读取挂起请求实际携带的 JSON 请求体。"""
603	        raw = paused["request"].get("postData")

610	            self.call("Fetch.disable", timeout=5)

content.thinking:
Now I understand the current state. 

Three bugs have been identified in the PAGE JavaScript's loadSurveys function: First, the fetch function doesn't reject for HTTP error statuses, which will trigger an unhandled rejection and leave the list blank. Second, a 200 response with an empty surveys array will display the wrong prompt. Third, a non-JSON response will trigger a generic error prompt without specifying the content cannot be parsed.

Four more bugs have been spotted: The network error prompt is unchanged from the general failure one, non-success HTTP statuses don't show the corresponding code, and existing tests cover specific failure hint checks.

I've confirmed the requirements for HTTP and network error prompts. Since existing tests will be replaced by the grading harness, I'll check all test files for relevant expected prompt content.

"""逐字段核对服务器草稿（id 不参与比较）。

        期望题目用 (type, title, required, options) 元组给出。
        """
        data = self.get_survey(survey_id)
        self.assertEqual(data["title"], expected["title"], f"{where}：服务器标题不符")
        self.assertEqual(data["description"], expected["description"],
                         f"{where}：服务器说明不符（必须原样保留）")
        self.assertEqual(
            [(q["type"], q["title"], q["required"], tuple(q["options"]))
             for q in data["questions"]],
            [(q[0], q[1], q[2], tuple(q[3])) for q in expected["questions"]],
            f"{where}：服务器题目/选项/必填/顺序与提交内容不符")

    def wait_detail(self, survey_id):
        self.page.wait_for(f"location.hash === '#/surveys/{survey_id}'")
        self.page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('.q-list')")

    def wait_new_detail(self, before_ids):
        """等待首次创建成功后进入详情，返回新问卷编号。"""
        self.page.wait_for("/^#\\/surveys\\/\\d+$/.test(location.hash)")
        self.page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('.q-list')")
        return self.created_id(before_ids, "进入详情后")

    # ---------- 主场景：等待期间继续编辑，首笔只保存快照，表单就地转为编辑 ----------

    def test_first_create_keeps_clicked_snapshot_and_adopts_edit_mode_when_dirty(self):
        page = self.page
        before_ids = self.known_ids()
        self.open_home()
        page.hold_saves()

        # 点击“保存整份问卷”时的完整内容：说明含中文、引号与换行；一道文本题
        # （必填）加一道三个选项的单选题。
        first_desc = '首存说明：含「中文引号」与“弯引号”、"直引号"\n第二行换行'
        page.t("setTitle", "首存问卷")
        page.t("setDesc", first_desc)
        page.t("addText", "首存文本题", True)
        page.t("addChoice", "首存单选题", ["选项甲", "选项乙", "选项丙"], False)
        first_expected = {
            "title": "首存问卷",
            "description": first_desc,
            "questions": [
                ("text", "首存文本题", True, []),
                ("single_choice", "首存单选题", False, ["选项甲", "选项乙", "选项丙"]),
            ],
        }

        paused = self.submit_and_catch_save()
        # 首次保存必须走创建接口，且请求体就是点击那一刻的完整内容。
        self.assertEqual(paused["request"]["method"], "POST",
                         "尚未取得编号时首次保存必须走创建接口")
        self.assertRegex(paused["request"]["url"], r"/api/surveys$")
        self.assertEqual(ChromePage.held_body(paused), {
            "title": "首存问卷",
            "description": first_desc,
            "questions": [
                {"type": "text", "title": "首存文本题", "required": True},
                {"type": "single_choice", "title": "首存单选题", "required": False,
                 "options": ["选项甲", "选项乙", "选项丙"]},
            ],
        }, "首次创建提交的不是点击那一刻的完整内容")

        # 等待结果期间：明确显示正在保存，保存按钮禁用，其余编辑全部可用。
        self.assert_saving_ui(page.snapshot(), "首次创建等待期间")

        # 等待期间修改说明与单选题选项：改文字、新增选项、删除首项（顺序改变）。
        page.t("setDesc", '等待期说明：改过的内容\n带"引号"')
        page.t("setOption", 1, 1, "选项乙改")
        page.t("addOption", 1, "选项丁")
        page.t("removeOption", 1, 0)                 # 删掉“选项甲”
        current_questions = [
            ("text", "首存文本题", True, []),
            ("single_choice", "首存单选题", False, ["选项乙改", "选项丙", "选项丁"]),
        ]
        # 等待期间的编辑立即体现在表单上，等待提示不被清掉。
        snapshot = page.snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["description"], '等待期说明：改过的内容\n带"引号"',
                         "首次创建等待期间：说明的修改没有留在表单上")
        self.assert_form_questions(snapshot, current_questions, "首次创建等待期间编辑后")
        self.assert_saving_ui(snapshot, "完成等待期编辑后")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""临时验证脚本：首页列表对失败响应与异常正文的处理。验证后删除。"""
import base64
import json
import sys
import time
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/gsb-production/workspaces/coco/prod-16/A/task024")
import test_home_list_stale_read as mod

ChromeBrowser = mod.ChromeBrowser
SurveyServer = mod.SurveyServer
EMPTY_HINT = mod.EMPTY_HINT
HTTP_FAIL = "问卷列表加载失败（HTTP {code}）。"
UNUSABLE = "问卷列表加载失败：返回内容无法作为问卷列表使用。"

results = []
def check(name, cond, extra=""):
    results.append((name, cond))
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name, extra)

def fulfill_raw(page, paused, status, body_bytes, content_type):
    page.call("Fetch.fulfillRequest", {
        "requestId": paused["requestId"],
        "responseCode": status,
        "responseHeaders": [{"name": "Content-Type", "value": content_type}],
        "body": base64.b64encode(body_bytes).decode("ascii"),
    })

def wait_text(page, text, timeout=8):
    end = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < end:
        t = page.listing()["text"] or ""
        if text in t:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.1)
    return False

browser = ChromeBrowser()
try:
    def fresh():
        srv = SurveyServer(); srv.start()
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.hold_reads()
        page.open(f"{srv.base_url}/#/")
        page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('#draft-form')")
        return srv, page

    def case(name, status, payload=None, raw=None, ctype="application/json; charset=utf-8",
             expect=EMPTY_HINT):
        srv, page = fresh()
        try:
            held = page.held_list(0)
            if raw is not None:
                fulfill_raw(page, held, status, raw, ctype)
            else:
                page.fulfill_json(held, status, payload)
            ok = wait_text(page, expect)
            listing = page.listing()
            check(name, ok and listing["items"] == [expect],
                  f"items={listing['items']!r}")
            check(name + "：无加载中", "加载中" not in (listing["text"] or ""))
            check(name + "：表单仍在",
                  bool(page.eval("!!document.getElementById('draft-form')")))
        finally:
            page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 非成功 HTTP 状态：错误 JSON / 普通文字 / 空内容 / 带 surveys 数组 ---
    case("500 错误 JSON", 500, {"error": "内部错误"}, expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 普通文字", 500, raw="服务器挂了".encode(), ctype="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 空内容", 500, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("502 错误文字", 502, raw="bad gateway".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=502))
    case("500 带 surveys 数组也不算成功", 500,
         {"surveys": [{"id": 9, "title": "伪装记录"}], "error": "x"},
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))

    # --- 成功状态但正文无法作为问卷列表 ---
    case("200 非 JSON 文字", 200, raw="oops".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 空内容", 200, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 缺少 surveys", 200, {"nope": []}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是字符串", 200, {"surveys": "x"}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是 null", 200, {"surveys": None}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数组", 200, raw=b"[]", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数字", 200, raw=b"123", expect=UNUSABLE)

    # --- 正常空数组仍显示空提示 ---
    case("200 空数组", 200, {"surveys": []}, expect=EMPTY_HINT)

    # --- 正常记录按编号升序展示，链接正确 ---
    srv, page = fresh()
    try:
        held = page.held_list(0)
        page.fulfill_json(held, 200, {"surveys": [
            {"id": 1, "title": "第一份"}, {"id": 2, "title": "第二份"}]})
        page.wait_for("document.querySelectorAll('#survey-list a').length === 2")
        listing = page.listing()
        check("正常列表条目", listing["items"] == ["#1 第一份", "#2 第二份"],
              repr(listing["items"]))
        check("正常列表链接", listing["hrefs"] == ["#/surveys/1", "#/surveys/2"])
        page.t("clickHref", "#/surveys/2")
        page.wait_for("location.hash === '#/surveys/2' && !!document.querySelector('h2')")
        check("点击打开对应详情",
              page.eval("document.querySelector('h2').textContent") == "#2 第二份")
    finally:
        page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 失败后通过已有操作（创建成功后的刷新）重新读取成功，取代失败提示；
    #     且创建不被改判、编号不解除、保存状态保留、后续保存仍改同一草稿 ---
    srv, page = fresh()
    try:
        initial = page.held_list(0)
        page.fulfill_json(initial, 500, {"error": "首次读取失败"})
        wait_text(page, HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
        check("首次读取 500 显示失败",
              page.listing()["items"] == [HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500)])

        page.t("setTitle", "创建时保存的标题")
        page.t("addText", "文本题一", True)
        page.t("submit")
        post = page.pop_held_post()
        page.t("setTitle", "等待期间改的新标题")
        page.release_to_server(post)
        refresh = page.held_list(1)
        page.wait_for(
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2') && "
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2').textContent.startsWith('编辑问卷草稿 #')")
        st, data = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        new_id = data["surveys"][-1]["id"]

        # 较晚发起的刷新成功：正常列表取代失败提示。
        page.fulfill_json(refresh, 200, {"surveys": [
            {"id": new_id, "title": "创建时保存的标题"}]})
        page.wait_for(f"document.querySelector('#survey-list a[href=\"#/surveys/{new_id}\"]')")
        listing = page.listing()
        check("刷新成功取代失败提示",
              listing["items"] == [f"#{new_id} 创建时保存的标题"], repr(listing["items"]))
        snap = page.snapshot()
        check("表单就地转为编辑且编号保留",
              snap["formHeading"] == f"编辑问卷草稿 #{new_id}", snap["formHeading"])
        check("等待期间修改保留在表单", snap["title"] == "等待期间改的新标题")
        check("已保存提示保留", "已保存" in snap["saveStatusText"])
        check("未保存修改提示保留", "未保存的修改" in snap["saveStatusText"])
        check("无错误 banner", not snap["bannerVisible"])

        # 较早的首次读取此刻才以成功旧列表返回，也不能覆盖（发起顺序规则）。
        page.settle(0.3)

        # 后续保存仍修改同一份草稿（PUT 同一编号），不走第二次创建。
        page.t("setTitle", "第二次保存的标题")
        page.t("submit")
        page.wait_for("!!document.getElementById('save-note-saved')")
        page.settle(0.4)
        st, after = srv.request("GET", f"/api/surveys/{new_id}")
        check("后续保存修改同一草稿", st == 200 and after["title"] == "第二次保存的标题",
              f"{st} {after.get('title')}")
        st, lst = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        check("没有创建出第二份问卷",
              [s["id"] for s in lst["surveys"]] == [new_id], str(lst))
    finally:
        page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 创建后刷新失败：不能改判创建；随后较早的首次读取成功也不能替换失败 ---
    helper_case = mod.HomeListStaleReadTests("test_stale_old_list_read_does_not_override_refresh")
    # 直接手工构造场景
    srv = SurveyServer(); srv.start()
    page = browser.new_page()
    try:
        page.hold_reads()
        page.open(f"{srv.base_url}/#/")
        page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('#draft-form')")
        initial = page.held_list(0)
        page.t("setTitle", "刷新失败的草稿")
        page.t("addText", "题目", False)
        page.t("submit")
        post = page.pop_held_post()
        page.t("setTitle", "等待期改动")
        page.release_to_server(post)
        refresh = page.held_list(1)
        page.wait_for(
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2') && "
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2').textContent.startsWith('编辑问卷草稿 #')")
        st, data = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        new_id = data["surveys"][-1]["id"]

        page.fulfill_json(refresh, 500, {"surveys": []})  # 500 且带空 surveys
        wait_text(page, HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
        check("刷新 500 显示失败而非空列表",
              page.listing()["items"] == [HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500)])
        snap = page.snapshot()
        check("刷新失败不改判创建",
              snap["formHeading"] == f"编辑问卷草稿 #{new_id}")
        check("刷新失败保留已保存/未保存提示",
              "已保存" in snap["saveStatusText"] and "未保存的修改" in snap["saveStatusText"])

        page.fulfill_json(initial, 200, {"surveys": []})
        page.settle(0.8)
        check("较早读取成功不能替换当前失败提示",
              page.listing()["items"] == [HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500)],
              repr(page.listing()["items"]))
    finally:
        page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

finally:
    browser.close()

failed = [n for n, ok in results if not ok]
print(f"\n{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} passed")
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""临时验证脚本：首页列表对失败响应与异常正文的处理。验证后删除。"""
import base64
import json
import sys
import time
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/gsb-production/workspaces/coco/prod-16/A/task024")
import test_home_list_stale_read as mod

ChromeBrowser = mod.ChromeBrowser
SurveyServer = mod.SurveyServer
EMPTY_HINT = mod.EMPTY_HINT
HTTP_FAIL = "问卷列表加载失败（HTTP {code}）。"
UNUSABLE = "问卷列表加载失败：返回内容无法作为问卷列表使用。"

results = []
def check(name, cond, extra=""):
    results.append((name, cond))
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name, extra)

def fulfill_raw(page, paused, status, body_bytes, content_type):
    page.call("Fetch.fulfillRequest", {
        "requestId": paused["requestId"],
        "responseCode": status,
        "responseHeaders": [{"name": "Content-Type", "value": content_type}],
        "body": base64.b64encode(body_bytes).decode("ascii"),
    })

def wait_text(page, text, timeout=8):
    end = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < end:
        t = page.listing()["text"] or ""
        if text in t:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.1)
    return False

browser = ChromeBrowser()
try:
    def fresh():
        srv = SurveyServer(); srv.start()
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.hold_reads()
        page.open(f"{srv.base_url}/#/")
        page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('#draft-form')")
        return srv, page

    def case(name, status, payload=None, raw=None, ctype="application/json; charset=utf-8",
             expect=EMPTY_HINT):
        srv, page = fresh()
        try:
            held = page.held_list(0)
            if raw is not None:
                fulfill_raw(page, held, status, raw, ctype)
            else:
                page.fulfill_json(held, status, payload)
            ok = wait_text(page, expect)
            listing = page.listing()
            check(name, ok and listing["items"] == [expect],
                  f"items={listing['items']!r}")
            check(name + "：无加载中", "加载中" not in (listing["text"] or ""))
            check(name + "：表单仍在",
                  bool(page.eval("!!document.getElementById('draft-form')")))
        finally:
            page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 非成功 HTTP 状态：错误 JSON / 普通文字 / 空内容 / 带 surveys 数组 ---
    case("500 错误 JSON", 500, {"error": "内部错误"}, expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 普通文字", 500, raw="服务器挂了".encode(), ctype="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 空内容", 500, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("502 错误文字", 502, raw="bad gateway".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=502))
    case("500 带 surveys 数组也不算成功", 500,
         {"surveys": [{"id": 9, "title": "伪装记录"}], "error": "x"},
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))

    # --- 成功状态但正文无法作为问卷列表 ---
    case("200 非 JSON 文字", 200, raw="oops".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 空内容", 200, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 缺少 surveys", 200, {"nope": []}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是字符串", 200, {"surveys": "x"}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是 null", 200, {"surveys": None}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数组", 200, raw=b"[]", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数字", 200, raw=b"123", expect=UNUSABLE)

    # --- 正常空数组仍显示空提示 ---
    case("200 空数组", 200, {"surveys": []}, expect=EMPTY_HINT)

    # --- 正常记录按编号升序展示，链接正确 ---
    srv, page = fresh()
    try:
        held = page.held_list(0)
        page.fulfill_json(held, 200, {"surveys": [
            {"id": 1, "title": "第一份"}, {"id": 2, "title": "第二份"}]})
        page.wait_for("document.querySelectorAll('#survey-list a').length === 2")
        listing = page.listing()
        check("正常列表条目", listing["items"] == ["#1 第一份", "#2 第二份"],
              repr(listing["items"]))
        check("正常列表链接", listing["hrefs"] == ["#/surveys/1", "#/surveys/2"])
        page.t("clickHref", "#/surveys/2")
        page.wait_for("location.hash === '#/surveys/2' && !!document.querySelector('h2')")
        check("点击打开对应详情",
              page.eval("document.querySelector('h2').textContent") == "#2 第二份")
    finally:
        page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 失败后通过已有操作（创建成功后的刷新）重新读取成功，取代失败提示；
    #     且创建不被改判、编号不解除、保存状态保留、后续保存仍改同一草稿 ---
    srv, page = fresh()
    try:
        initial = page.held_list(0)
        page.fulfill_json(initial, 500, {"error": "首次读取失败"})
        wait_text(page, HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
        check("首次读取 500 显示失败",
              page.listing()["items"] == [HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500)])

        page.t("setTitle", "创建时保存的标题")
        page.t("addText", "文本题一", True)
        page.t("submit")
        post = page.pop_held_post()
        page.t("setTitle", "等待期间改的新标题")
        page.release_to_server(post)
        refresh = page.held_list(1)
        page.wait_for(
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2') && "
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2').textContent.startsWith('编辑问卷草稿 #')")
        st, data = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        new_id = data["surveys"][-1]["id"]

        # 较晚发起的刷新成功：正常列表取代失败提示。
        page.fulfill_json(refresh, 200, {"surveys": [
            {"id": new_id, "title": "创建时保存的标题"}]})
        page.wait_for(f"document.querySelector('#survey-list a[href=\"#/surveys/{new_id}\"]')")
        listing = page.listing()
        check("刷新成功取代失败提示",
              listing["items"] == [f"#{new_id} 创建时保存的标题"], repr(listing["items"]))
        snap = page.snapshot()
        check("表单就地转为编辑且编号保留",
              snap["formHeading"] == f"编辑问卷草稿 #{new_id}", snap["formHeading"])
        check("等待期间修改保留在表单", snap["title"] == "等待期间改的新标题")
        check("已保存提示保留", "已保存" in snap["saveStatusText"])
        check("未保存修改提示保留", "未保存的修改" in snap["saveStatusText"])
        check("无错误 banner", not snap["bannerVisible"])

        # 较早的首次读取此刻才以成功旧列表返回，也不能覆盖（发起顺序规则）。
        page.settle(0.3)

        # 后续保存仍修改同一份草稿（PUT 同一编号），不走第二次创建。
        page.t("setTitle", "第二次保存的标题")
        page.t("submit")
        page.wait_for("!!document.getElementById('save-note-saved')")
        page.settle(0.4)
        st, after = srv.request("GET", f"/api/surveys/{new_id}")
        check("后续保存修改同一草稿", st == 200 and after["title"] == "第二次保存的标题",
              f"{st} {after.get('title')}")
        st, lst = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        check("没有创建出第二份问卷",
              [s["id"] for s in lst["surveys"]] == [new_id], str(lst))
    finally:

def fulfill_raw(page, paused, status, body_bytes, content_type):

        "requestId": paused["requestId"],
        "responseCode": status,
        "responseHeaders": [{"name": "Content-Type", "value": content_type}],
        "body": base64.b64encode(body_bytes).decode("ascii"),
    })

def wait_text(page, text, timeout=8):
    end = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < end:
        t = page.listing()["text"] or ""
        if text in t:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.1)
    return False

        page = browser.new_page()

        page.open(f"{srv.base_url}/#/")
        page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('#draft-form')")
        return srv, page

    def case(name, status, payload=None, raw=None, ctype="application/json; charset=utf-8",
             expect=EMPTY_HINT):
        srv, page = fresh()
        try:
            held = page.held_list(0)
            if raw is not None:
                fulfill_raw(page, held, status, raw, ctype)
            else:
                page.fulfill_json(held, status, payload)
            ok = wait_text(page, expect)
            listing = page.listing()
            check(name, ok and listing["items"] == [expect],
                  f"items={listing['items']!r}")
            check(name + "：无加载中", "加载中" not in (listing["text"] or ""))
            check(name + "：表单仍在",
                  bool(page.eval("!!document.getElementById('draft-form')")))
        finally:
            page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 非成功 HTTP 状态：错误 JSON / 普通文字 / 空内容 / 带 surveys 数组 ---
    case("500 错误 JSON", 500, {"error": "内部错误"}, expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 普通文字", 500, raw="服务器挂了".encode(), ctype="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 空内容", 500, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("502 错误文字", 502, raw="bad gateway".encode(), ctype="text/plain",

        page.wait_for("document.querySelectorAll('#survey-list a').length === 2")
        listing = page.listing()

              listing["items"] == [f"#{real_id} 第一份", f"#{second_id} 第二份（仅列表）"],

        check("正常列表链接",

        page.t("clickHref", f"#/surveys/{real_id}")
        page.wait_for(

    finally:

"""临时验证脚本：首页列表对失败响应与异常正文的处理。验证后删除。"""
import base64
import json
import sys
import time
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/gsb-production/workspaces/coco/prod-16/A/task024")
import test_home_list_stale_read as mod

ChromeBrowser = mod.ChromeBrowser
SurveyServer = mod.SurveyServer
EMPTY_HINT = mod.EMPTY_HINT
HTTP_FAIL = "问卷列表加载失败（HTTP {code}）。"
UNUSABLE = "问卷列表加载失败：返回内容无法作为问卷列表使用。"

results = []
def check(name, cond, extra=""):
    results.append((name, cond))
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name, extra)

def fulfill_raw(page, paused, status, body_bytes, content_type):
    page.call("Fetch.fulfillRequest", {
        "requestId": paused["requestId"],
        "responseCode": status,
        "responseHeaders": [{"name": "Content-Type", "value": content_type}],
        "body": base64.b64encode(body_bytes).decode("ascii"),
    })

def wait_text(page, text, timeout=8):
    end = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < end:
        t = page.listing()["text"] or ""
        if text in t:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.1)
    return False

browser = ChromeBrowser()
try:
    def fresh():
        srv = SurveyServer(); srv.start()
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.hold_reads()
        page.open(f"{srv.base_url}/#/")
        page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('#draft-form')")
        return srv, page

    def case(name, status, payload=None, raw=None, ctype="application/json; charset=utf-8",
             expect=EMPTY_HINT):
        srv, page = fresh()
        try:
            held = page.held_list(0)
            if raw is not None:
                fulfill_raw(page, held, status, raw, ctype)
            else:
                page.fulfill_json(held, status, payload)
            ok = wait_text(page, expect)
            listing = page.listing()
            check(name, ok and listing["items"] == [expect],
                  f"items={listing['items']!r}")
            check(name + "：无加载中", "加载中" not in (listing["text"] or ""))
            check(name + "：表单仍在",
                  bool(page.eval("!!document.getElementById('draft-form')")))
        finally:
            page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 非成功 HTTP 状态：错误 JSON / 普通文字 / 空内容 / 带 surveys 数组 ---
    case("500 错误 JSON", 500, {"error": "内部错误"}, expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 普通文字", 500, raw="服务器挂了".encode(), ctype="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 空内容", 500, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("502 错误文字", 502, raw="bad gateway".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=502))
    case("500 带 surveys 数组也不算成功", 500,
         {"surveys": [{"id": 9, "title": "伪装记录"}], "error": "x"},
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))

    # --- 成功状态但正文无法作为问卷列表 ---
    case("200 非 JSON 文字", 200, raw="oops".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 空内容", 200, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 缺少 surveys", 200, {"nope": []}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是字符串", 200, {"surveys": "x"}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是 null", 200, {"surveys": None}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数组", 200, raw=b"[]", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数字", 200, raw=b"123", expect=UNUSABLE)

    # --- 正常空数组仍显示空提示 ---
    case("200 空数组", 200, {"surveys": []}, expect=EMPTY_HINT)

    # --- 正常记录按编号升序展示，链接正确（详情需真实存在，先种一份） ---
    srv, page = fresh()
    try:
        st, created = srv.request("POST", "/api/surveys", {
            "title": "第一份",
            "questions": [{"type": "text", "title": "题"}]})
        real_id = created["id"]
        second_id = real_id + 1
        held = page.held_list(0)
        page.fulfill_json(held, 200, {"surveys": [

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""临时验证脚本：首页列表对失败响应与异常正文的处理。验证后删除。"""
import base64
import json
import sys
import time
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/gsb-production/workspaces/coco/prod-16/A/task024")
import test_home_list_stale_read as mod

ChromeBrowser = mod.ChromeBrowser
SurveyServer = mod.SurveyServer
EMPTY_HINT = mod.EMPTY_HINT
HTTP_FAIL = "问卷列表加载失败（HTTP {code}）。"
UNUSABLE = "问卷列表加载失败：返回内容无法作为问卷列表使用。"

results = []
def check(name, cond, extra=""):
    results.append((name, cond))
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name, extra)

def fulfill_raw(page, paused, status, body_bytes, content_type):
    page.call("Fetch.fulfillRequest", {
        "requestId": paused["requestId"],
        "responseCode": status,
        "responseHeaders": [{"name": "Content-Type", "value": content_type}],
        "body": base64.b64encode(body_bytes).decode("ascii"),
    })

def wait_text(page, text, timeout=8):
    end = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < end:
        t = page.listing()["text"] or ""
        if text in t:
            return True
        time.sleep(0.1)
    return False

browser = ChromeBrowser()
try:
    def fresh():
        srv = SurveyServer(); srv.start()
        page = browser.new_page()
        page.hold_reads()
        page.open(f"{srv.base_url}/#/")
        page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('#draft-form')")
        return srv, page

    def case(name, status, payload=None, raw=None, ctype="application/json; charset=utf-8",
             expect=EMPTY_HINT):
        srv, page = fresh()
        try:
            held = page.held_list(0)
            if raw is not None:
                fulfill_raw(page, held, status, raw, ctype)
            else:
                page.fulfill_json(held, status, payload)
            ok = wait_text(page, expect)
            listing = page.listing()
            check(name, ok and listing["items"] == [expect],
                  f"items={listing['items']!r}")
            check(name + "：无加载中", "加载中" not in (listing["text"] or ""))
            check(name + "：表单仍在",
                  bool(page.eval("!!document.getElementById('draft-form')")))
        finally:
            page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 非成功 HTTP 状态：错误 JSON / 普通文字 / 空内容 / 带 surveys 数组 ---
    case("500 错误 JSON", 500, {"error": "内部错误"}, expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 普通文字", 500, raw="服务器挂了".encode(), ctype="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("500 空内容", 500, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
    case("502 错误文字", 502, raw="bad gateway".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=502))
    case("500 带 surveys 数组也不算成功", 500,
         {"surveys": [{"id": 9, "title": "伪装记录"}], "error": "x"},
         expect=HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))

    # --- 成功状态但正文无法作为问卷列表 ---
    case("200 非 JSON 文字", 200, raw="oops".encode(), ctype="text/plain",
         expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 空内容", 200, raw=b"", ctype="text/plain", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 缺少 surveys", 200, {"nope": []}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是字符串", 200, {"surveys": "x"}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 surveys 是 null", 200, {"surveys": None}, expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数组", 200, raw=b"[]", expect=UNUSABLE)
    case("200 顶层是数字", 200, raw=b"123", expect=UNUSABLE)

    # --- 正常空数组仍显示空提示 ---
    case("200 空数组", 200, {"surveys": []}, expect=EMPTY_HINT)

    # --- 正常记录按编号升序展示，链接正确（详情需真实存在，先种一份） ---
    srv, page = fresh()
    try:
        st, created = srv.request("POST", "/api/surveys", {
            "title": "第一份",
            "questions": [{"type": "text", "title": "题"}]})
        real_id = created["id"]
        second_id = real_id + 1
        held = page.held_list(0)
        page.fulfill_json(held, 200, {"surveys": [
            {"id": real_id, "title": "第一份"},
            {"id": second_id, "title": "第二份（仅列表）"}]})
        page.wait_for("document.querySelectorAll('#survey-list a').length === 2")
        listing = page.listing()
        check("正常列表条目",
              listing["items"] == [f"#{real_id} 第一份", f"#{second_id} 第二份（仅列表）"],
              repr(listing["items"]))
        check("正常列表链接",
              listing["hrefs"] == [f"#/surveys/{real_id}", f"#/surveys/{second_id}"])
        page.t("clickHref", f"#/surveys/{real_id}")
        page.wait_for(
            f"location.hash === '#/surveys/{real_id}' && !!document.querySelector('h2')")
        check("点击打开对应详情",
              page.eval("document.querySelector('h2').textContent")
              == f"#{real_id} 第一份")
    finally:
        page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 失败后通过已有操作（创建成功后的刷新）重新读取成功，取代失败提示；
    #     且创建不被改判、编号不解除、保存状态保留、后续保存仍改同一草稿 ---
    srv, page = fresh()
    try:
        initial = page.held_list(0)
        page.fulfill_json(initial, 500, {"error": "首次读取失败"})
        wait_text(page, HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
        check("首次读取 500 显示失败",
              page.listing()["items"] == [HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500)])

        page.t("setTitle", "创建时保存的标题")
        page.t("addText", "文本题一", True)
        page.t("submit")
        post = page.pop_held_post()
        page.t("setTitle", "等待期间改的新标题")
        page.release_to_server(post)
        refresh = page.held_list(1)
        page.wait_for(
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2') && "
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2').textContent.startsWith('编辑问卷草稿 #')")
        st, data = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        new_id = data["surveys"][-1]["id"]

        # 较晚发起的刷新成功：正常列表取代失败提示。
        page.fulfill_json(refresh, 200, {"surveys": [
            {"id": new_id, "title": "创建时保存的标题"}]})
        end = time.time() + 8
        sel = (f"!!document.querySelector('#survey-list a[href=\"#/surveys/{new_id}\"]')")
        while time.time() < end and not page.eval(sel):
            time.sleep(0.15)
        got = page.eval(sel)
        if not got:
            print("DEBUG items:", page.listing()["items"], "held:", page.list_read_count(),
                  "hash:", page.eval("location.hash"))
        check("刷新成功取代失败提示", bool(got), repr(page.listing()["items"]))
        snap = page.snapshot()
        check("表单就地转为编辑且编号保留",
              snap["formHeading"] == f"编辑问卷草稿 #{new_id}", snap["formHeading"])
        check("等待期间修改保留在表单", snap["title"] == "等待期间改的新标题")
        check("已保存提示保留", "已保存" in snap["saveStatusText"])
        check("未保存修改提示保留", "未保存的修改" in snap["saveStatusText"])
        check("无错误 banner", not snap["bannerVisible"])

        # 较早的首次读取此刻才以成功旧列表返回，也不能覆盖（发起顺序规则）。
        page.settle(0.3)

        # 后续保存仍修改同一份草稿（PUT 同一编号），不走第二次创建。
        page.t("setTitle", "第二次保存的标题")
        page.t("submit")
        page.wait_for("!!document.getElementById('save-note-saved')")
        page.settle(0.4)
        st, after = srv.request("GET", f"/api/surveys/{new_id}")
        check("后续保存修改同一草稿", st == 200 and after["title"] == "第二次保存的标题",
              f"{st} {after.get('title')}")
        st, lst = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        check("没有创建出第二份问卷",
              [s["id"] for s in lst["surveys"]] == [new_id], str(lst))
    finally:
        page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

    # --- 创建后刷新失败：不能改判创建；随后较早的首次读取成功也不能替换失败 ---
    srv = SurveyServer(); srv.start()
    page = browser.new_page()
    try:
        page.hold_reads()
        page.open(f"{srv.base_url}/#/")
        page.wait_for("!!document.querySelector('#draft-form')")
        initial = page.held_list(0)
        page.t("setTitle", "刷新失败的草稿")
        page.t("addText", "题目", False)
        page.t("submit")
        post = page.pop_held_post()
        page.t("setTitle", "等待期改动")
        page.release_to_server(post)
        refresh = page.held_list(1)
        page.wait_for(
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2') && "
            "document.querySelector('#draft-form h2').textContent.startsWith('编辑问卷草稿 #')")
        st, data = srv.request("GET", "/api/surveys")
        new_id = data["surveys"][-1]["id"]

        page.fulfill_json(refresh, 500, {"surveys": []})  # 500 且带空 surveys
        wait_text(page, HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500))
        check("刷新 500 显示失败而非空列表",
              page.listing()["items"] == [HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500)])
        snap = page.snapshot()
        check("刷新失败不改判创建",
              snap["formHeading"] == f"编辑问卷草稿 #{new_id}")
        check("刷新失败保留已保存/未保存提示",
              "已保存" in snap["saveStatusText"] and "未保存的修改" in snap["saveStatusText"])

        page.fulfill_json(initial, 200, {"surveys": []})
        page.settle(0.8)
        check("较早读取成功不能替换当前失败提示",
              page.listing()["items"] == [HTTP_FAIL.format(code=500)],
              repr(page.listing()["items"]))
    finally:
        page.stop_holding(); page.close(); srv.stop()

finally:
    browser.close()

failed = [n for n, ok in results if not ok]
print(f"\n{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} passed")
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)

content.text:
已修复首页问卷列表对服务端错误与异常正文的误判，改动只在 `app.py` 内嵌前端的 `loadSurveys`（首页列表读取，app.py:636-686）。

## 问题根因

旧代码不看 HTTP 状态码，直接 `await resp.json()` 后就访问 `data.surveys`：
- 返回 500 + `{"error":...}` 能解析成 JSON，但 `data.surveys` 为 `undefined`，访问 `.length` 抛异常——而此时“加载中…”已被清空，异常又抛在 try/catch 之外，列表永久空白、一直停在加载后的空状态。
- 返回错误状态但正文带 `{"surveys":[]}` 时，被当成成功的空列表，误显示“还没有问卷记录”。
- 200 但正文不是 JSON、或缺 `surveys`、`surveys` 不是数组时，也没有按失败处理。

## 修复方式（四个判定阶段）

1. **网络中断**（fetch reject）：保留现有提示“问卷列表加载失败。”。
2. **非成功状态**（`!resp.ok`）：整体替换列表为“问卷列表加载失败（HTTP {实际状态码}）。”，不读取/不依据正文——错误 JSON、纯文字、空内容、带 `surveys` 数组一律不算成功。
3. **成功状态但正文不可用**：JSON 解析失败，或 `surveys` 缺失/不是数组 → “问卷列表加载失败：返回内容无法作为问卷列表使用。”，绝不回退成“还没有问卷记录”。
4. **仅当 2xx 且 `surveys` 为数组**才渲染：空数组显示“还没有问卷记录。”，有记录按编号升序显示编号与标题、点击进详情。

失败/提示统一走 `showListMessage` 整体替换列表，因此不会只剩空白、不会卡在“加载中…”，也不会残留上一次的记录被误认为本次成功。

## 边界与回归保障

- 每次更新前后都保留原有的 `view`/`listLoadSeq` 守卫：较早首页读取后报错不会覆盖创建后的刷新结果；离开首页后才返回的错误不会出现在详情/编辑页；之后通过“创建成功后的刷新”等已有操作重新读取成功时，正常列表会取代失败提示。
- 列表逻辑与表单完全独立：草稿已创建、等待期间有修改而留在表单时，随后刷新失败不会改判创建、不解除已取得的编号、不清空“已保存/仍有未保存修改”提示，后续保存仍 PUT 同一编号。

验证：`node --check` 与 `py_compile` 通过；现有全部 58 个真实 Chrome 浏览器用例 + 4 个 HTTP 用例全部通过。另用临时脚本（已删除）通过 CDP 伪造了 500/502 的错误 JSON/纯文字/空内容/带 surveys 正文、200 的非 JSON/空体/缺 surveys/surveys 非数组、正常空数组与记录，以及“失败→创建刷新恢复→再次保存仍改同一草稿”等场景，共 56 项断言全部通过。
